meta.title: Luma Ray 3.2 vs Veo 3.1 Fast: Cinematic Drafts, Audio & Best Uses
meta.description: Compare Luma Ray 3.2 and Veo 3.1 Fast for cinematic motion, video-to-video control, reframe tools, native audio, speed, scorecard ratings and best use cases.

en.heroIntro: Use Luma Ray 3.2 when the creative problem is source-video control: Modify Video, Reframe, guide frames, cinematic motion preservation, and 1080p visual iteration without native audio. Use Veo 3.1 Fast when the brief needs a faster Veo-style draft, native audio options, higher delivery headroom, and premium short-form polish before moving into final production. This comparison is most useful for teams deciding whether the next pass should edit or reframe existing motion, or generate a more polished audio-ready Veo draft.

items.question: When should I choose Luma Ray 3.2 over Veo 3.1 Fast?
items.answer: Choose Luma Ray 3.2 when source-video editing, reframe control, guide frames, and preserving or redirecting existing motion are more important than native audio.

items.question: When is Veo 3.1 Fast better?
items.answer: Choose Veo 3.1 Fast when you need a faster premium visual draft, native audio options, stronger final polish, or more delivery headroom than Luma Ray 3.2 provides.

items.question: Which one is better for product or ad tests?
items.answer: Luma Ray 3.2 is stronger when you already have source footage to modify or reframe. Veo 3.1 Fast is stronger for fresh cinematic drafts, audio-ready ad concepts, and high-polish short tests.

items.question: 何时应该选择 Luma Ray 3.2 而非 Veo 3.1 Fast？
items.answer: 源视频编辑、重新构图、引导帧，以及保留或重新引导现有运动比原生音频更重要时，选择 Luma Ray 3.2。

items.question: 何时 Veo 3.1 Fast 更合适？
items.answer: 需要更快的高品质视觉草稿、原生音频选项、更精细成片或比 Luma Ray 3.2 更多交付空间时，选择 Veo 3.1 Fast。

items.question: 哪款更适合产品或广告测试？
items.answer: 已有源素材需修改 / 重新构图时，Luma Ray 3.2 更有优势；全新电影草稿、含音频广告概念和精细短测试更适合 Veo 3.1 Fast。
